Article 8 (Perusal and Copying of Judgment Documents, etc. of Appellate Courts)
Article 59-3 of the Criminal Procedure Act and the Rules on Perusal and Copying of Criminal Judgment Documents, etc. shall apply mutatis mutandis to the perusal and copying of judgment documents, etc. of appellate courts and related matters. [Amended on June 30, 2022.]
